Kimberly / Sara — taking operational inventory. Quick notes:

- No-training enforcement: We have a platform-level flag ("customer_no_train") that, when enabled, routes traffic to an inference path that disables telemetry capture for model update pipelines and zeroes the training payloads before any telemetry export. The attached "no-train-ops-diagram.png" shows request flow and the gate where data is dropped from training pipelines.

- Subprocessors: current list attached (subprocessor_inventory_2026-08.csv). Column summary: name, service, processing_location (US/EU/APAC), data_exposure (raw_prompts|responses|anonymized_telemetry). For hosted customers we use two optional cloud analytics vendors; both are flagged as "anonymized_telemetry" only when the no-train flag is active.

- KMS residency and encryption: our customer-managed KMS option pins keys to region; we can provide a short checklist (kms-residency-checklist.xlsx) demonstrating how keys are configured and where backups live.

- Attestation: Operationally, we can sign an attestation template indicating (i) the flag exists, (ii) the subprocessors and their processing zones, and (iii) that we run quarterly verification checks. Note that signing a permanent legal attestation may need a short legal review; we can provide an ops-attestation for procurement immediately.

Deliverables (ETA):
- One-page cover letter + DPA addendum text — 24 hours
- Subprocessor inventory export + ops diagram + KMS checklist — 24–36 hours
- Ops attestation (template) — 48 hours (legal signoff needed for final)

If PulseAI needs on-prem or VPC deployment to keep all processing in their chosen region, we can outline the Private deployment option and estimated timeline.

-David

David Kim
Director, Platform Security & Privacy | Redwood Inference
